title: Fly-In Safaris: Pros and Cons
excerpt: Flying between parks saves time and gives great views. The pros and cons of a fly-in safari.
body:
## Pros

- Saves long drives.
- More time in the parks.
- Views from the air.
- Access to remote parks.

## Cons

- Higher cost.
- Luggage limits. See [luggage limits](/blog/domestic-flights-luggage/).
- Less contact with daily life along the road.
- A different guide at each destination.

## Combination

Drive in, fly out: a common middle way.

## Who it suits

Travellers with limited time and those visiting remote parks.

[Plan your fly-in safari](/travel-proposal/).
